title: USC OIS: Reduced Course Load (curated summary)
text:
USC Reduced Course Load (RCL) is an authorized exception to the normal enrollment load for international students. Eligibility depends on the reason, supporting documentation, and OIS authorization; a student's preference alone is not approval.
USC academic-difficulty RCL: the source addresses initial language, reading, teaching-method, or course-placement difficulties in the first semester. It is limited to one authorization per degree level. The student must retain at least half-time enrollment and obtain OIS approval before reducing registration; consult the page for unit thresholds and submission timing.
USC medical RCL: a temporary health condition may support reduced or, where approved, zero enrollment. The student needs appropriate U.S. medical-provider documentation and prior academic-department and OIS approvals. Authorization is semester-specific, with limits at the degree level. Treatment outside the U.S. calls for reviewing leave-of-absence guidance instead. Do not upload medical records to this chatbot; discuss a personal case directly with OIS.
curation_note: Concise paraphrase checked against the linked USC page via web retrieval. Not a complete page snapshot or a substitute for OIS advice.
